is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis) in Tanzania.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper states: 'This study did not report the results for kdr mutation as they were inconclusive and at a very low frequency.' (Page 8). No other resistance markers listed in the criteria were genotyped.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper explicitly states that kdr mutation results were not reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 20 sentinel sites in Tanzania mainland.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is reported for 20 specific sentinel sites/districts in Tanzania (e.g., Arumeru, Babati, Bagamoyo, etc.).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field work was carried out between May and June 2015.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary field study conducted in 2015.

supplement.evidence: All relevant data (bioassay mortality rates and biochemical enzyme activity) are provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. across 20 sites in Tanzania in 2015 using WHO bioassays and biochemical assays for metabolic resistance. While the study identified species composition and resistance phenotypes, it did not report any genotype data for resistance markers, explicitly stating that kdr results were inconclusive.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper explicitly states that kdr mutation results were not reported as they were inconclusive.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype data for resistance markers is provided.
